mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no AS business_order_no, COALESCE(po.tracking_no, obr.tracking_no) AS sf_tracking_no, o.tenant_id, t.tenant_name, o.destination_country, o.declared_weight, o.declared_length, o.declared_width, o.declared_height, o.declared_volume_weight, m.actual_weight, m.actual_length, m.actual_width, m.actual_height, m.actual_volume_weight, o.chargeable_weight, o.estimated_fee, o.current_fee, o.currency, COALESCE(a.difference_amount, 0) AS fee_difference, CASE o.current_status WHEN 'PENDING_INBOUND' THEN 'PENDING_INBOUND' WHEN 'INBOUND' THEN 'PENDING_MEASUREMENT' WHEN 'READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' THEN 'PENDING_OUTBOUND' WHEN 'OUTBOUND' THEN 'OUTBOUND' WHEN 'IN_TRANSIT' THEN 'IN_TRANSIT' WHEN 'DELIVERED' THEN 'DELIVERED' ELSE o.current_status END AS warehouse_status, o.current_status AS logistics_status, o.version, obr.outbound_at, obr.outbound_by, o.created_at

FROM shipment_order o JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id AND t.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN shipment_package p ON p.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND p.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wm.tenant_id, wm.shipment_package_id, wm.actual_weight, wm.actual_length, wm.actual_width, wm.actual_height, wm.actual_volume_weight FROM warehouse_measurement wm JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, shipment_package_id, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM warehouse_measurement GROUP BY tenant_id, shipment_package_id) latest ON latest.tenant_id=wm.tenant_id AND latest.shipment_package_id=wm.shipment_package_id AND latest.latest_id=wm.id ) m ON m.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND m.shipment_package_id=p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fa.tenant_id, fa.shipment_order_id, fa.difference_amount FROM fee_adjustment fa JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, shipment_order_id, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM fee_adjustment GROUP BY tenant_id, shipment_order_id) latest_fee ON latest_fee.tenant_id=fa.tenant_id AND latest_fee.shipment_order_id=fa.shipment_order_id AND latest_fee.latest_id=fa.id ) a ON a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
